messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, May 28, 2027 at 3:24 PM PDT
Subject: Post-discovery: quick cost qualification + requested artifacts

Hi Asha / Tom —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking us through the Cobalt Health workflow and the key latency/PII constraints. As promised, here’s a concise recap of the things we need to firm up so we can produce an accurate invoice estimate and token-level cost model: 

1) Expected monthly token consumption (starter / month 1, month 6, month 12).
2) Preferred deployment mode (hosted API vs. Redwood Dedicated vs. Private VPC).
3) Target unit economics — do you have an internal $/1M target we should aim for?
4) Any firm budget ranges for Q3 (monthly or annual).
5) Compliance or legal constraints that affect pricing (SLA, data residency).

I attached a tiny questionnaire (pricing_calc_questionnaire.xlsx) that speeds up modeling — if you can fill the token estimates and budget row, we’ll turn around an invoice sketch and 3 pricing bands (pilot, committed, enterprise).

Quick note on approach: for early pilots we typically propose a hosted pilot with a soft-commit discount and a path to Dedicated once throughput is stable. For volume estimates under ~50M tokens/mo we show hosted; above that we model Dedicated savings and quantization options. If you have a target $/1M tokens, we’ll center the scenarios around that.

Next steps: if you can drop the completed questionnaire and your month-by-month forecast by EOD Tuesday (May 31), Ben and I will prepare an invoice sketch + an attachment with unit-econ assumptions.

Thanks — talk soon.

—

Thanks Jasmine — good conversation. Attaching our rough consumption forecast (consumption_forecast.csv). Answers inline below: 

- Starter / month 1: 30M tokens (pilot with 3 product teams)
- Month 6: 70M tokens
- Month 12: 130M tokens (full internal rollout across 6 teams)
- Preferred deployment: hosted to start, Dedicated evaluation at ~100M tokens/mo
- Target unit economics: our procurement target is ~$850 / 1M tokens (we can stretch to $1,100 for strong SLA + support)
- Budget: initial pilot budget ~ $25k / month; target ramp to $90k / month by month 12
- Compliance: data residency in US only; SOC2 required.

Can you produce a simple invoice estimate at the $850 / 1M baseline and then one at $1,100 / 1M with Dedicated savings modeled? We prefer a short summary PDF we can share with procurement.

Asha

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, May 29, 2027 at 10:02 AM PDT
Subject: Fwd: Cobalt Health numbers — draft unit-econ and pilot offer (internal)

Internal — quick sketch based on Asha’s numbers. I pulled together a costing sheet (redwood_pricing_calc_v2.xlsx) and ran three scenarios: Hosted @ $0.85k per 1M, Hosted @ $1.1k per 1M, and Dedicated transition at 100M+ tokens with a 30% infra cost reduction. Key points: 

- Pilot (30M/mo): Hosted estimate at Asha’s $850/1M -> ~$25.5k/mo (tokens) + typical support line items (~$3k) -> ~ $28.5k/month. With a 10% pilot discount we can present ~$25.6k as the pilot invoice.
- Ramp (70M/mo): Hosted @ $850/1M -> ~$59.5k tokens; dedicated starts to pay off near 100M but we can show a committed discount structure (tiered bands) to incentivize commit.
- Enterprise (130M/mo): Model Dedicated baseline infra + 8:1 batching gains + int8 quantization -> estimated unit cost to us drops ~35%, allowing us to offer blended price near $650–$750/1M with a 12‑month commit.

Recommendation: Offer a two-phase commercial path: 
  * Phase 1: 3-month hosted pilot (10% pilot credit) with target invoice ~ $25.6k/mo.
  * Phase 2: 12-month committed transition at blended $750/1M (or equivalent committed spend) with priority capacity and SOC2 evidence bundle.

Ask: Jasmine, want to propose the pilot numbers + the two-band committed alternative in a short PDF (1 page) and send to Asha/Tom Monday morning? If Sergio thinks we need an additional concession (early termination credit or extended trial), flag it and I’ll bake it into the sheet.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>

Hi Asha / Tom —

Thanks for the forecast and clarity — attached is a concise invoice estimate PDF (invoice_estimate_Cobalt-v1.pdf) plus the small pricing assumptions sheet Ben referenced. TL;DR on the three scenarios we prepared: 

1) Pilot — Hosted, 30M tokens/mo: list price modeled at $850/1M -> token charges ~$25,500/mo. We applied a 10% pilot credit (one-time across first invoice) -> pilot invoice shown at ~$25.6k.
2) Committed ramp — 70M/mo midpoint: hosted math at $850/1M shows ~$59.5k/mo; we show a committed discount ladder and a dedicated transition at ~100M that reduces unit cost materially.
3) Enterprise — 130M/mo: recommended commercial: 12-month commit at blended $750/1M with priority capacity, SOC2 evidence package, and a migration plan to Dedicated.

Attached: invoice_estimate_Cobalt-v1.pdf (one-page summary), redwood_pricing_calc_v2.xlsx (assumptions). HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 (I’ve added the forecast).

Next steps: 
- If this aligns, can procurement confirm which scenario they prefer? We’ll prepare a formal quote + SOW.
- If they want Dedicated in pilot, note that Dedicated onboarding adds ~3–4 weeks and an infra setup fee; we can include both options in the formal quote.

If you want, Ben and I can hop on a quick 30-minute call tomorrow to walk procurement through the one-page PDF.

Best,
Jasmine
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
